$description: Lumen v0.13 — EXPRESSIVE-mode glass primitives. Four named recipes for floating shells (popover, sheet, command palette, hero device frame, nav). NEVER on canvas / data table / row / cell — see AGENTS.md hard rule 16. Each recipe ships four atomic tokens (tint / blur / saturate / border) plus a CSS-shorthand `filter` string for consumers that want a single `backdrop-filter` declaration. Each also carries a `fallback` solid surface for `@supports not (backdrop-filter)` and `prefers-reduced-transparency` — the v0.13 modes/expressive scaffolding wires these as @media + @supports overrides in dist/css/lumen.scoping.css. Restrained mode keeps the v0.12.6 semantic surface.glass alias (which resolves to alpha.ink.62 on dark, alpha.paper.72 on light) — these primitives are the expressive equivalents.

subtle.$description: Inline glass moments — tag chips, inline pills, soft popovers. 40% alpha + 12px blur reads barely-there.

tint.$description: 40% ink alpha on dark canvas. (Light-mode equivalent rebinds via the semantic surface.glass alias.)

border.$description: Hairline at paper-alpha-6% — the system's default border.hairline value on dark.

fallback.$description: Solid surface for @supports not (backdrop-filter) and prefers-reduced-transparency.

default.$description: Default popover / sheet glass per /foundations page. 50% alpha + 20px blur + 140% saturate — the v0.12.6 anchor. Master doc Phase 0 specifies this as the canonical floating-shell glass.

tint.$description: v0.11.13-anchored 62% ink alpha — the master surface.glass value on dark.

strong.$description: Modal + full-screen sheet + hero device frame. 60% alpha + 28px blur + 160% saturate — the heavier glass for moments where the floating shell needs to read decisively above its backdrop.

fallback.$description: Heavy ink at 84% — reads decisively without backdrop-filter support.

tinted-accent.$description: Spring-Green tinted floating shell — for AI surface popovers, live-update toasts, success-state sheets. The accent appears AT the moment of action — these glass shells are mounted at action-moments only.

tint.$description: 8–12% Spring Green tint over the ink alpha — composed via background: linear-gradient at consumption.

border.$description: Spring-green hairline — the master-doc-named border.accent value.

fallback.$description: Spring-green tint at 24% over canvas — reads as 'accent surface' without backdrop-filter.
